title: MotionInsight: Diagnosing Object Motion Deficiencies in Generated Videos
abstract: arXiv:2609.37030v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite rapid progress in video generation models, they still exhibit obvious motion deficiencies, often manifested as incorrect object motion. However, most existing video quality evaluations focus on aesthetic quality or text-video alignment. To address this gap, we study object-centric motion fidelity assessment, evaluating target objects along object consistency, motion continuity, and physical plausibility. To achieve this, we first introduce VidMotion, a diagnostic dataset of 6,879 videos with designated moving objects and fine-grained annotations including dimension-wise scores and failure causes. We further propose MotionInsight, a diagnostic evaluator that shifts assessment from implicit RGB-frame observation to explicit motion-space diagnosis. translated_title: MotionInsight：诊断生成视频中的物体运动缺陷
translated_abstract: 尽管视频生成模型取得了快速进展，但它们仍然表现出明显的运动缺陷，通常表现为错误的物体运动。然而，大多数现有的视频质量评估侧重于美学质量或文本-视频对齐。为了填补这一空白，我们研究了以物体为中心的运动保真度评估，从物体一致性、运动连续性和物理合理性三个维度评估目标物体。为此，我们首先介绍了VidMotion，一个包含6,879个视频的诊断数据集，这些视频具有指定的运动物体和细粒度标注，包括各维度的分数和失败原因。我们进一步提出了MotionInsight，一个诊断评估器，它将评估从隐式的RGB帧观察转变为显式的运动空间诊断。通过构建运动感知的表示，MotionInsight使细微的运动缺陷更加容易被观察到。我们还在GRPO训练过程中引入了运动特定的奖励，以将观察到的...
tldr: 该论文提出VidMotion诊断数据集与MotionInsight评估器，将视频评估从隐式RGB帧观察转变为显式运动空间诊断，从物体一致性、运动连续性和物理合理性三个维度评估并诊断生成视频中目标物体的运动缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces VidMotion, a diagnostic dataset, and MotionInsight, an evaluator that shifts assessment from implicit RGB-frame observation to explicit motion-space diagnosis, evaluating object motion fidelity across object consistency, motion continuity, and physical plausibility to diagnose motion deficiencies in generated videos.
